items.quote: Sie können binnen drei Monaten ab Zugang dieses Schreibens kostenfrei kündigen; der Vertrag endet frühestens mit Wirksamwerden der Änderung.
items.computation: The period runs 'ab Zugang' (from actual receipt), not from the letter's date (05.12.2025, a Friday). No received_date was given by the person and this sender is a private company, not an authority, so the statutory deemed-delivery rules (e.g. § 122 AO's 4-day rule) do not apply directly; as a practical estimate I assume ordinary postal delivery of about 3 calendar days, i.e. receipt on Monday 08.12.2025. Under § 187(1) BGB the day of receipt itself is not counted, so the period starts 09.12.2025. Under § 188(2) BGB a period of months ends with the day of the last month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. 08.03.2026. That day is a Sunday; unlike a submission deadline, a notice/termination period is not extended by § 193 BGB to the next business day (settled case law, e.g. BGH III ZR 172/04), so the letter must reach Muster Mobil GmbH by 08.03.2026 at the latest — in practice it should be sent by early March to be safe.
